title: Simultaneous normalized presentations and their counit adjunct
statement: Fix the finite-field and coefficient setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and finite coefficient subfields of a fixed $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and fix $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$, $p:Z\to Y$ with $j$ open, $p$ proper, and $f=p\circ j$ a $k$-morphism smooth of pure relative dimension $d\ge0$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the actual complete finite-Tor integral categories, completed pullback and tensor, and the specified compact-support/exceptional adjunctions of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude, def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Fix an arbitrary specified integral coefficient ring system $S$. There exist $M$, a field-extension result $R$ of [det-sp-field-extension-towers], and normalized stages $A_E$ of [def-pur-tower-trace-comparison-data] for all finite fields $E$, such that each $a^T_E$ is invertible and has the prescribed finite reductions. For every finite-Tor input $K$, if $J_E$ is the normalized tensor-source isomorphism and $u_E(K)$ is inverse projection followed by $(\epsilon_EP_E(a^T_E))\otimes1_K$ and the normalized right unitor, then the inverse specified adjunction Hom equivalence sends $J_E^{-1}\gamma^T_{E,K}$ to $S.\mathrm{left}_{E,J_EK}\,u_E(K)$. This is a statement about integral presentations and adjuncts only; it asserts no scalar-trace or rational comparison.

proof.text: Choose the simultaneous field-extension models. Apply the realized tower transpose at each finite field and transport its realization to the chosen model by the fully faithful reconstruction equivalence and unique counit-preserving right-adjoint comparison. Normalize all source, tensor, unit and finite exceptional comparisons on their fixed representatives. Finite-Tor closure and the projection formula fill Stage. The unit finite reductions and invertibility follow from the realized transpose theorem; its counit identity in these coordinates is the displayed inverse homEquiv identity.

theorem normalized_presentations [QuasiCompact (j ≫ p)]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (S : ConstructibleExceptionalCoefficients.RingSystem P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.Qbar
      P.field P.coefficients.different (f := j ≫ p)) :
    ∃ (M : FieldShriekSystem.Models P) (R : FieldExtensionTowers.Result P M j p d)
      (A : ∀ E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P, Stage P j p d S M E (R.model E)),
      (∀ E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P,
        PrescribedUnitReductions P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E)
          (orientation P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E)) ∧
        IsIso (orientation P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E))) ∧
      ∀ (E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P)
        (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory P.coefficients.l E.val Y),
        ((S.operation (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)
          (.integral { carrier := E.val })).adjunction.homEquiv
            ⟨_, (A E).tensorTor K⟩ K).symm
              (ObjectProperty.homMk ((A E).tensorSource.inv.app K ≫
                tower P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E) K)) =
          ObjectProperty.homMk
            ((S.left (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)
              (.integral { carrier := E.val })).hom.app ⟨_, (A E).tensorTor K⟩ ≫
              adicTraceMap P.coefficients.l E.val (A E).models (A E).openComparison
                (SpTowerGamma.factorization j p)
                (PurUnitTrace.tateUnit P.field P.coefficients E.val d X) K.obj
                ((A E).completionIso K) ((A E).projectionIso K)
                (counitTrace P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E)
                  (orientation P j p d S M E (R.model E) (A E)) ≫ (A E).unitIso.hom))
